```{ojs}
//| output: false
import {reactivity, KEV, E_FUS, E_ALPHA, C_B} from "./fusion.js"
import {INK, MUTED, GREY, BLUE, ORANGE, GREEN} from "./plotting.js"
rx = FileAttachment("data/reactivity.json").json()
font = ({fontFamily: "'STIX Two Text', serif", fontSize: "16px", color: INK, background: "transparent"})
// Approximate published design or machine parameters (see the Sources line); M = 2.5 (D-T).
devices = ({
  "ITER (tokamak)": {kind: "tok", R: 6.2, a: 2.0, kappa: 1.7, B: 5.3, I: 15, betaN: 3.0, nmax: 2.0},
  "SPARC (tokamak)": {kind: "tok", R: 1.85, a: 0.57, kappa: 1.75, B: 12.2, I: 8.7, betaN: 3.0, nmax: 9.0},
  "ARC (tokamak)": {kind: "tok", R: 3.3, a: 1.13, kappa: 1.84, B: 9.2, I: 7.8, betaN: 3.0, nmax: 3.0},
  "W7-X (stellarator)": {kind: "stel", R: 5.5, a: 0.53, kappa: 1, B: 2.5, iota: 0.9, betaMax: 0.05, nmax: 3.0},
  "HELIAS 5-B (stellarator)": {kind: "stel", R: 22, a: 1.8, kappa: 1, B: 5.6, iota: 0.9, betaMax: 0.05, nmax: 4.0},
})
sub = (svg) => {
  for (const t of svg.querySelectorAll("text")) {
    if (!/[_^]/.test(t.textContent)) continue;
    t.innerHTML = t.textContent
      .replace(/_(\w+)/g, '<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="72%">$1</tspan>')
      .replace(/\^(\S+)/g, '<tspan baseline-shift="super" font-size="72%">$1</tspan>');
  }
  return svg;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
dev = ({...devices[device], B: Bfield})
// Volume-averaged n = n_e and T (T_e = T_i); parabolic profiles
// n = n0 (1 - s)^an, T = T0 (1 - s)^aT in s = rho^2 (dV = V ds). Powers in MW.
an = 0.2
fuel = 0.85   // n_D + n_T = 0.85 n_e (helium ash and impurities); n_i = 0.87 n_e
aT = 1.0
nLine = (1 + an) * Math.sqrt(Math.PI) / 2 * Math.exp(lgamma(an + 1) - lgamma(an + 1.5))  // line / volume average
lgamma = (z) => {  // Lanczos, z > 0
  const g = 7, c = [0.99999999999980993, 676.5203681218851, -1259.1392167224028, 771.32342877765313,
    -176.61502916214059, 12.507343278686905, -0.13857109526572012, 9.9843695780195716e-6, 1.5056327351493116e-7];
  z -= 1; let x = c[0]; for (let i = 1; i < 9; i++) x += c[i] / (z + i);
  const t = z + g + 0.5; return 0.5 * Math.log(2 * Math.PI) + (z + 0.5) * Math.log(t) - t + Math.log(x);
}
point = (n20, T) => {
  const d = dev, n = n20 * 1e20, V = 2 * Math.PI ** 2 * d.R * d.a * d.a * d.kappa, K = 24;
  let fus = 0, br = 0;
  for (let k = 0; k < K; k++) {
    const s = (k + 0.5) / K, nk = n * (1 + an) * (1 - s) ** an, Tk = Math.max(T * (1 + aT) * (1 - s) ** aT, 0.05);
    fus += (fuel * nk) ** 2 / 4 * reactivity(rx, "DT", Tk) / K;
    br += nk * nk * Math.sqrt(Tk) / K;
  }
  const W = 1.5 * (1 + fuel + 0.02) * n * T * KEV * V / 1e6 * (1 + an) * (1 + aT) / (1 + an + aT);   // MJ
  const Pf = fus * E_FUS * KEV * V / 1e6;
  const Pa = Pf * E_ALPHA / E_FUS, Pb = C_B * br * V / 1e6;
  const nl19 = 10 * n20 * nLine;
  // tau_E = A P^-alpha with the loss power P = W / tau_E solved exactly: P = (W/A)^(1/(1-alpha)).
  let A, alpha;
  if (d.kind === "tok") {  // IPB98(y,2)
    A = H * 0.0562 * d.I ** 0.93 * d.B ** 0.15 * nl19 ** 0.41 * d.R ** 1.97 * (d.a / d.R) ** 0.58 * d.kappa ** 0.78 * 2.5 ** 0.19;
    alpha = 0.69;
  } else {                 // ISS04
    A = H * 0.134 * d.a ** 2.28 * d.R ** 0.64 * nl19 ** 0.54 * d.B ** 0.84 * d.iota ** 0.41;
    alpha = 0.61;
  }
  const P = (W / A) ** (1 / (1 - alpha)), tau = W / P;
  const Pext = P + Pb - Pa, Q = Pext > 0 ? Pf / Pext : Infinity;
  const beta = 2 * 4e-7 * Math.PI * 2 * W * 1e6 / 3 / V / (d.B * d.B);
  const limit = d.kind === "tok"
    ? Math.max(nl19 / 10 / (d.I / (Math.PI * d.a * d.a)), beta / (d.betaN * 0.01 * d.I / (d.a * d.B)))
    : Math.max(beta / d.betaMax, nl19 / 10 / (0.25 * Math.sqrt(Math.max(Pa + Math.max(Pext, 0), 1e-6) * d.B / (d.a * d.a * d.R))));
  return {Pf, Pa, Pb, P, Pext, Q, tau, beta, W, limit, allowed: limit <= 1};
}
Tdom = [3, 30]
ndom = [0.05, dev.nmax]
// Sampled on a pixel grid by Plot.raster and Plot.contour (x1..x2, y1..y2).
cache = (point, new Map())   // rebuilt whenever the device or H changes
at = (T, n20) => {
  const key = `${T.toFixed(3)},${n20.toFixed(4)}`;
  let v = cache.get(key);
  if (!v) { v = point(n20, T); cache.set(key, v); }
  return v;
}
extent = ({x1: Tdom[0], x2: Tdom[1], y1: ndom[0], y2: ndom[1], width: 110, height: 90})
best = {
  let b = null, ign = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < 110; i++) for (let j = 0; j < 90; j++) {
    const T = Tdom[0] + (Tdom[1] - Tdom[0]) * (i + 0.5) / 110, n20 = ndom[0] + (ndom[1] - ndom[0]) * (j + 0.5) / 90;
    const g = point(n20, T);
    if (!g.allowed) continue;
    const cand = {T, n20, ...g};
    if (g.Pext <= 0) { if (!ign || g.Pf > b.Pf) b = cand; ign = true; }
    else if (!ign && (!b || g.Q > b.Q)) b = cand;
  }
  return {b, ign};
}
pLabels = [10, 100, 1000, 3000].map((P) => {
  const T = Tdom[1], unit = point(1, T).Pf, n20 = Math.sqrt(P / unit);
  return {T, n20, label: P >= 1000 ? `${P / 1000} GW` : `${P} MW`};
}).filter((d) => d.n20 > ndom[0] && d.n20 < ndom[1])
qLegend = Plot.legend({color: {type: "linear", domain: [-1, 1.6], range: ["#FFFFFF", "#7FB2DA"]}, width: 280, label: "gain Q",
  ticks: [-1, 0, Math.log10(5), 1, Math.log10(30)], tickFormat: (v) => ({"-1": "0.1", "0": "1", "1": "10"}[String(v)] ?? (Math.abs(v - Math.log10(5)) < 1e-9 ? "5" : "30")),
  style: {fontFamily: "'STIX Two Text', serif", fontSize: "13px"}})
qColour = (q) => q === Infinity ? 1.6 : Math.log10(Math.max(q, 0.1))
```

```{ojs}
html`<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start">${sub(Plot.plot({
  width: 640, height: 392, marginLeft: 60, marginRight: 64, marginTop: 26, marginBottom: 50, style: font,
  x: {domain: Tdom, label: "⟨k_B T⟩ [keV]", labelAnchor: "center", labelArrow: "none", labelOffset: 40},
  y: {domain: ndom, label: "⟨n⟩ [10^20 m^−3]", labelArrow: "none"},
  color: {type: "linear", domain: [-1, 1.6], range: ["#FFFFFF", "#7FB2DA"], clamp: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.raster({...extent, fill: (T, n) => qColour(at(T, n).Q), imageRendering: "auto"}),
    Plot.contour({...extent, fill: null, value: (T, n) => qColour(at(T, n).Q), thresholds: [0, Math.log10(5), 1, Math.log10(30)], stroke: BLUE, strokeWidth: 1.6}),
    Plot.contour({...extent, fill: null, value: (T, n) => Math.log10(at(T, n).Pf), thresholds: [1, 2, 3, Math.log10(3000)], stroke: ORANGE, strokeDasharray: "5,4", strokeWidth: 1.4}),
    Plot.contour({...extent, value: (T, n) => Math.min(at(T, n).limit, 10), thresholds: [1], fill: "#9AA5B1", fillOpacity: 0.75, stroke: null}),
    Plot.contour({...extent, fill: null, value: (T, n) => at(T, n).limit, thresholds: [1], stroke: INK, strokeWidth: 2.2}),
    best.b ? Plot.dot([best.b], {x: "T", y: "n20", r: 7, fill: "white", stroke: INK, strokeWidth: 2.5}) : null,
    Plot.text(pLabels, {x: "T", y: "n20", text: "label", fill: ORANGE, fontSize: 13, textAnchor: "start", dx: 4, clip: false}),
    Plot.frame({stroke: GREY}),
  ],
}))}
<div style="font-size:0.78rem;line-height:1.4;width:300px;color:${INK}">
  ${qLegend}
  <div style="color:${MUTED}">blue lines: <i>Q</i> = 1, 5, 10, 30 · orange: <i>P</i><sub>fus</sub> [MW]<br>grey: beyond ${dev.kind === "tok" ? "Greenwald or β<sub>N</sub>" : "β or Sudo density"} limit</div>
  ${best.b ? html`<div style="margin-top:0.6rem"><b>${best.ign ? "ignited, highest P<sub>fus</sub> ○" : "highest allowed <i>Q</i> ○"}</b><br>
  <i>k</i><sub>B</sub><i>T</i> = ${best.b.T.toFixed(1)} keV, <i>n</i> = ${best.b.n20.toFixed(2)} × 10<sup>20</sup> m<sup>−3</sup><br>
  <i>Q</i> = ${best.ign ? "∞" : best.b.Q.toFixed(1)}, <i>P</i><sub>fus</sub> = ${best.b.Pf.toFixed(0)} MW<br>
  <i>τ</i><sub>E</sub> = ${best.b.tau.toFixed(2)} s, <i>β</i> = ${(100 * best.b.beta).toFixed(1)} %<br>
  <i>P</i><sub>ext</sub> = ${Math.max(best.b.Pext, 0).toFixed(0)} MW, <i>P</i><sub>α</sub> = ${best.b.Pa.toFixed(0)} MW</div>` : html`<div style="margin-top:0.6rem">no allowed point with net heating</div>`}
  <div style="color:${MUTED};margin-top:0.6rem;font-size:0.68rem">0-D, parabolic profiles (<i>α</i><sub>n</sub> = 0.2, <i>α</i><sub>T</sub> = 1), fuel 85 % of <i>n</i><sub>e</sub>, axes volume averages, <i>T</i><sub>e</sub> = <i>T</i><sub>i</sub>, bremsstrahlung only; <i>τ</i><sub>E</sub> = H·IPB98(y,2) or H·ISS04 with <i>P</i> = <i>W</i>/<i>τ</i><sub>E</sub> solved self-consistently. Trends, not design values.</div>
</div></div>`
```

```{ojs}
viewof device = Inputs.select(Object.keys(devices), {value: "ITER (tokamak)", label: "device"})
viewof Bfield = Inputs.range([1, 20], {value: devices[device].B, step: 0.1, label: html`<i>B</i> [T]`})
viewof H = Inputs.range([0.5, 2], {value: 1, step: 0.05, label: html`H factor`})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
{
  for (const [view, v] of [[viewof Bfield, `${Bfield.toFixed(1)} T`], [viewof H, H.toFixed(2)]]) {
    const div = view.querySelector("div");
    const out = div.querySelector("output") ?? div.appendChild(document.createElement("output"));
    out.textContent = v;
  }
}
```
